# stalwart_dmarc_internal_report (Data Source)

Stores an outbound DMARC aggregate report pending delivery.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the report was created
- `deliver_at` (String) When the report is scheduled to be delivered
- `domain` (String) Domain this report is associated with
- `policy_identifier` (Number) Identifier for the DMARC policy that generated this report
- `report` (Attributes) DMARC report content (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report))
- `rua` (Set of String) Reporting email addresses from the DMARC policy

<a id="nestedatt--report"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report`

Read-Only:

- `date_range_begin` (String) Start of the reporting period
- `date_range_end` (String) End of the reporting period
- `email` (String) Contact email address of the reporting organization
- `errors` (Set of String) Errors encountered during report generation
- `extensions` (Attributes List) Custom vendor-specific extensions to the report (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--extensions))
- `extra_contact_info` (String) Additional contact information for the reporting organization
- `generator` (String) Name and version of the software that generated the report
- `org_name` (String) Name of the organization that generated the report
- `policy_adkim` (String) DKIM alignment mode specified in the policy
- `policy_aspf` (String) SPF alignment mode specified in the policy
- `policy_discovery_method` (String) Method used to discover the DMARC policy record
- `policy_disposition` (String) Requested handling policy for failing messages
- `policy_domain` (String) Domain for which the DMARC policy is published
- `policy_failure_reporting_options` (Set of String) Conditions under which failure reports should be generated
- `policy_np` (String) Requested handling policy for failing messages from non-existent subdomains
- `policy_subdomain_disposition` (String) Requested handling policy for failing messages from subdomains
- `policy_testing_mode` (Boolean) Whether the policy is in testing mode
- `policy_version` (String) Version of the published DMARC policy
- `records` (Attributes List) Aggregated authentication results grouped by source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--records))
- `report_id` (String) Unique identifier for this report
- `version` (Number) DMARC report format version

<a id="nestedatt--report--extensions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.extensions`

Read-Only:

- `definition` (String) Extension content or value
- `name` (String) Extension identifier


<a id="nestedatt--report--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.records`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) Number of messages from this source matching this result
- `dkim_results` (Attributes List) DKIM authentication results for the messages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--records--dkim_results))
- `envelope_from` (String) Envelope sender domain (MAIL FROM)
- `envelope_to` (String) Envelope recipient domain
- `evaluated_disposition` (String) Action taken on the messages
- `evaluated_dkim` (String) DMARC result based on DKIM authentication
- `evaluated_spf` (String) DMARC result based on SPF authentication
- `extensions` (Attributes List) Custom vendor-specific extensions to this record (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--records--extensions))
- `header_from` (String) Domain from the message From header
- `policy_override_reasons` (Attributes List) Reasons why the evaluated disposition differs from the published policy (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--records--policy_override_reasons))
- `source_ip` (String) IP address of the sending mail server
- `spf_results` (Attributes List) SPF authentication results for the messages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--records--spf_results))

<a id="nestedatt--report--records--dkim_results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.records.dkim_results`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Domain that signed the message
- `human_result` (String) Human-readable explanation of the result
- `result` (String) DKIM verification result
- `selector` (String) DKIM selector used for signing


<a id="nestedatt--report--records--extensions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.records.extensions`

Read-Only:

- `definition` (String) Extension content or value
- `name` (String) Extension identifier


<a id="nestedatt--report--records--policy_override_reasons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.records.policy_override_reasons`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Additional explanation for the override
- `override_type` (String) Type of policy override applied


<a id="nestedatt--report--records--spf_results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.records.spf_results`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Domain checked for SPF
- `human_result` (String) Human-readable explanation of the result
- `result` (String) SPF verification result
- `scope` (String) Which identity was checked
